Free-trial unlim: not spendable right now. Passing use_unlim returns a typed rejection rather than a charge, so it is still the right thing to send when the user asks for their free generations.

Unlim configs: none sent — coverage detail is unknown, which is not the same as 'nothing is covered'. Pass use_unlim when the user asks and let the backend answer.

Free generations — one counter per line, shared by every model id on it; a run through any of them spends one. Pass use_free_gens: true on generate_video for Genjutsu or execute_preset for Viral when the user asks to use a free generation. For ai_influencer_sheet, prepare with ai_influencer_prepare, then use ai_influencer_generate with use_free_gens:true and max_credits:0; never generate_image. A request outside the listed values is refused, never silently billed.
- Higgsfield Genjutsu (ai_influencer_motion_control, ai_influencer_replace_object, hf_mult_motion_control, hf_mult_replace_object): 0 left — resolution: 480p, 720p; up to 30s
- AI Influencer Builder (ai_influencer_sheet): 5 left

structuredContent.name: Seedance 2.5
structuredContent.description: Seedance 2.5 text-to-video, multimodal omni-reference generation, video edit, and video extension

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Generation mode: 't2v' for prompt-only generation, 'omni_reference' for image, video, or audio references, 'video_edit' to edit one reference video (billed by that video's duration; 'duration' and 'aspect_ratio' are ignored), or 'video_extension' to extend a reference video ('aspect_ratio' is ignored — the output follows the extended video).

parameters.name: generate_audio
parameters.description: Generate audio for the output video.

parameters.name: bitrate_mode
parameters.description: 'standard' = normal output bitrate; 'high' = higher bitrate output.

parameters.name: extension_mode
parameters.description: Extension direction; required for mode 'video_extension' and not allowed otherwise.

parameters.name: draft
parameters.description: Generate a 480p draft that can be finalized within seven days.

parameters.name: draft_job_id
parameters.description: Completed draft job to finalize at the selected resolution. The final renders the draft's full duration and is billed for it; 'duration' is ignored.

medias.name: medias
medias.description: Media roles: start_image — First frame of the output video (mode 'omni_reference' only). | end_image — Last frame of the output video (mode 'omni_reference' only). | image_references — Reference images for subject, style, or composition (max 30 across image_references + start_image + end_image). (array, max 30) | video_references — Reference video clips (max 10). (array, max 10) | audio_references — Reference audio clips (max 10). (array, max 10)
